For vaginal 4% cream, apply one applicatorful intravaginally at bedtime for 3 consecutive days. 3. For 100 mg vaginal suppositories, insert one suppository intravaginally at bedtime for 7 consecutive days. 4. For 200 mg vaginal suppositories, insert one suppository intravaginally at bedtime for 3 consecutive days. 5. For 1,200 mg vaginal suppositories, insert one suppository intravaginally as a single dose. Drug Interactions with Miconazole Vaginal: 6. Pimozide: Miconazole vaginal increases pimozide levels by inhibiting its metabolism. This combination is contraindicated due to the risk of QT interval prolongation. 7. Progesterone Intravaginal Gel: Miconazole vaginal may alter progesterone release. Do not use with other vaginal products. This combination is contraindicated. 8. Dihydroergotamine (oral and intranasal): Miconazole vaginal increases dihydroergotamine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 9. Dronedarone: Miconazole vaginal increases dronedarone levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 10. Ergotamine: Miconazole vaginal increases ergotamine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 11. Erythromycin (base, ethylsuccinate, lactobionate, stearate): Miconazole vaginal increases erythromycin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 12. Everolimus: Miconazole vaginal increases everolimus levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 13. Lovastatin: Miconazole vaginal increases lovastatin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 14. Ranolazine: Miconazole vaginal increases ranolazine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 15. Silodosin: Miconazole vaginal increases silodosin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 16. Simvastatin: Miconazole vaginal increases simvastatin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 17. Sirolimus: Miconazole vaginal increases sirolimus levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. 18. Tolvaptan: Miconazole vaginal increases tolvaptan levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Use with Caution/Monitor: 19. Almotriptan: Miconazole vaginal increases almotriptan levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use with caution and monitor. 20. Alprazolam: Miconazole vaginal increases alprazolam levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use with caution and monitor. 21. Amiodarone: Miconazole vaginal increases amiodarone levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use with caution and monitor. 22. Aprepitant: Miconazole vaginal increases aprepitant levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use with caution and monitor. 23. Aripiprazole: Miconazole vaginal increases aripiprazole levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use with caution and monitor. 24. Artemether/Lumefantrine: Miconazole vaginal increases artemether/lumefantrine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use with caution and monitor. 25. Atorvastatin: Miconazole vaginal increases atorvastatin levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use with caution and monitor. 26. Bazedoxifene/Conjugated Estrogens: Miconazole vaginal increases levels of these drugs by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use with caution and monitor. 27. Budesonide: Miconazole vaginal increases budesonide levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use with caution and monitor. 28. Buspirone: Miconazole vaginal increases buspirone levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use with caution and monitor. 29. Carbamazepine: Miconazole vaginal increases carbamazepine levels by inhibiting CYP3A4 metabolism. Use with caution and monitor. 30. Carvedilol: Miconazole vaginal increases carvedilol levels by inhibiting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Use with caution and monitor.
